    c = query_object_instance(kn_id=kn, ot_id="supply_ontology_hand_salesorder", limit=1)
    print("ALL_SALES_ORDERS_TOTAL:", c.get("total_count"))

all_rows, offset, page = [], 0, 200
while True:
    r = query_object_instance(kn_id=kn, ot_id="supply_ontology_hand_salesorder",
                              condition=cond, limit=page, offset=offset,
                              sort=[{"field": "sales_order_id", "direction": "asc"}])
